title: Unit 25 Review: Language Variation
goal: Recognize peninsular leísmo, laísmo, and loísmo, distinguish the accepted male-person leísmo, and supply standard lo/la/le forms

items: I can recognize peninsular leísmo, laísmo, and loísmo, distinguish the accepted male-person leísmo, and supply standard lo/la/le forms
I can interpret tuteo, Rioplatense voseo, and regional ustedeo with consistent verb, clitic, and possessive agreement
I can discuss transatlantic vocabulary, phonetic features (seseo, ceceo, aspiración), and the pluricentric standard in formal register
